t: Versatile, spray-on waterproofing treatment specially formulated for outdoor equipment and footwear. Easy to apply. Keeps the user dry and protected from rain and stains, and is ideal for refreshing the repellency of seams, zips and other hard-to-reach areas that need reproofing. Suitable for suede, nubuck, nylon, polyester, canvas, ventile, polycotton, ripstop, eVent and Gore-Tex.
